usedFor: Hostfully holds rental bookings, and WhatsApp Business Cloud (Meta) messages guests through “Send Template Message” on each “New Booking”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Booking” in Hostfully, then “Send Template Message” in WhatsApp Business Cloud (Meta)
bestTemplate.why: The guest receives a confirmation template, sent through your WhatsApp Business Cloud (Meta) account as the booking lands.

watchOut: Hostfully's “Updated Booking” and “Cancelled Booking” events need their own wording, or guests get confirmation text on changes.
